description: Fetch progress counters for a bulk job, and optionally the per-number results. Free — a read uses no validations, but it does count against the account's per-minute request limit, so check about once a minute rather than in a loop: a job only moves at its plan's pace. Call with include_results once status is "completed".

include_results.description: Include per-number results instead of counters only. Default false.

name: get_job_status
